svg.text: The release notes are less exciting than the engineering habit they reveal:

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: small changes, clear compatibility promises, and boringly repeatable builds.

svg.text: In C, the quiet part of a design is often the ownership model. A reader can

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: look minimal while its structs make every allocation and free visible.
